# Pakistan Provincial Reform Institute (PPRI)

> PPRI is an independent, non-partisan public-policy research institute providing empirical data, cartographic scenario modeling, and constitutional legal analysis on provincial restructuring, federalism, public finance, and municipal devolution in Pakistan.

PPRI examines how governance, representation, public resources, and administrative institutions are structured across Pakistan — from the federation to provinces and local government tiers.

## Core Articles & Research Papers
- [The Provincial Reorganization of Pakistan](https://ppripakistan.github.io/research/policy-papers/provincial-reorganization-of-pakistan.html): PPRI flagship paper examining constitutional, administrative, fiscal, demographic, and local-government questions.
- [Income Went Up. So Why Does Life Feel Harder?](https://ppripakistan.github.io/research/reports/income-went-up-why-does-life-feel-harder.html): Empirical analysis of household income vs purchasing power squeeze in Pakistan.
- [The Price of a Simple Task](https://ppripakistan.github.io/research/reports/price-of-a-simple-task-pakistan-bureaucracy-cost.html): Bureaucratic transaction costs and the Administrative Burden Index.
- [Same Country, Different Life](https://ppripakistan.github.io/research/reports/same-country-different-life-district-access.html): District-level spatial disparities in education, water, electricity, and food security.
- [The Bribe You Can't See](https://ppripakistan.github.io/research/reports/bribe-you-cant-see-corruption-private-tax.html): Corruption as an informal tax on citizens and small enterprises.
- [Does Money Work Better Spent Closer to the People?](https://ppripakistan.github.io/research/reports/does-money-work-better-spent-closer-to-people.html): Local government finance and fiscal decentralization across Pakistan's cities.

## Institutional Frameworks & Law
- [Constitutional Framework](https://ppripakistan.github.io/provinces/constitutional-framework.html): Articles 1, 140A, 160, and 239 governing territorial restructuring.
- [Fiscal Framework](https://ppripakistan.github.io/provinces/fiscal-framework.html): National Finance Commission (NFC) transfers, provincial revenue, and transition costs.
- [Administrative Design](https://ppripakistan.github.io/provinces/administrative-model.html): Civil service, judiciary, law enforcement, and municipal administration models.
- [Local Government](https://ppripakistan.github.io/provinces/local-government.html): Constitutional local-government devolution under Article 140A.

## Interactive Tools & Data
- [Scenario Lab](https://ppripakistan.github.io/maps/scenarios/index.html): Interactive district-level cartographic scenario testing engine.
- [Data Centre & Observatory](https://ppripakistan.github.io/data/centre.html): NFC divisible pool reform simulator, population benchmarks, and district indicators.
- [Source Registry & Standards](https://ppripakistan.github.io/methodology/research-standards.html): Institutional documentation, data citations, and analytical standards.
